description: Chargers in a city or state, filtered the way drivers ask: "Electrify America chargers in Phoenix", "CHAdeMO chargers in Seattle", "150 kW chargers in Denver". Filters: city, state, network, connector (NACS/Tesla, CCS, CHAdeMO, J1772), speed, min_power_kw and live availability. Each station comes with its address, network, connector types, power in kW, port counts, access hours, price where known, the date its details were last confirmed and its page link (url); results are sorted by station name.

available_now.description: Only stations showing a free port in a live reading under 15 minutes old. Live availability is available only to clients with a commercial API key; without one, this filter is ignored and the answer lists it under ignored_filters.

city.description: City name, e.g. Denver (with state for a common name)

connector.description: Plug type, case-insensitive: NACS (Tesla), CCS, CHAdeMO or J1772, or a raw NREL code (TESLA, J1772COMBO, CHADEMO). Comma-separate to match any.

min_power_kw.description: Minimum charger power in kW (e.g. 50, 150, 250). 150 and up only match stations with a known wattage.

network.description: Network name contains, e.g. Tesla, Electrify America, ChargePoint

speed.description: Charging level: dcfc (DC fast), level2 or level1

state.description: State: two-letter abbreviation (CO), name (Colorado) or slug (colorado)

name: search_stations
title: Search charging stations
